## Story DD Coverage
- dd-5: Unit tests written and passing for all new logic

GREEN implementation that turns RED tests (tasks 1–4) green. dd-1 through dd-4 tested by tasks 1–5; this task makes those tests pass.

## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] fetcher.py defines SilentTruncationError inline
  Verify: grep -E 'class SilentTruncationError' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/fetcher.py
- [ ] fetcher.py exposes _iter_pages generator and collect wrapper
  Verify: grep -E 'def _iter_pages|def collect' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/fetcher.py
- [ ] fetcher.py uses the new JQL string
  Verify: grep -F 'project = DIG AND (resolution = Unresolved OR updated >= -1h)' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/fetcher.py
- [ ] fetcher.py emits dedup BRIDGE_ALERT via alert_store
  Verify: grep -F 'fetcher-dedup-suppressed' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/fetcher.py && grep -F 'alert_store' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/fetcher.py
- [ ] All four new unit tests + modified snapshot test pass (GREEN confirmation)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_fetcher_snapshot.py tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_fetcher_pagination_jql.py tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_fetcher_truncation_gate.py tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_fetcher_dedup_observable.py

## Implementation Notes
- Refactor plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/fetcher.py:
  - Add _iter_pages(jql) generator yielding one page (list of issue dicts)
  - Add collect(jql) wrapper maintaining seen_keys: set[str] and snapshot: dict[str, dict]
  - Update JQL constant to: project = DIG AND (resolution = Unresolved OR updated >= -1h)
  - Inline per-page truncation gate: page returns exactly page_size (100) AND cumulative len(snapshot) >= 1000 AND ACLI total/isLast does NOT strictly confirm '<1000 in working set' → raise SilentTruncationError
  - Fallback same-token-twice gate: if start_at value or nextPageToken repeats across two consecutive pages with identical first key → raise SilentTruncationError(reason='same-token-twice')
  - Per-issue dedup: if key in seen_keys → alert_store.write('fetcher-dedup-suppressed', {'key': key}); continue
  - Define SilentTruncationError inline (following RescheduleError pattern in applier.py:33)
- Reuse alert_store.py — do NOT create a new bridge_alerts module
- Do NOT modify differ.py

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: GREEN: refactor fetcher.py to generator + truncation gate + dedup
